title: Data Cost Notice
description: Stops a big download, upload or autoplay eating a data plan or hanging on a slow line: on Data Saver, mobile data or a slow connection (Network Information API, or a Save-Data header passed in) it shows the size and an honest rough time (never calling a line at Chrome's 10 Mbps cap slow, uploads as "over"), offers the lighter version with what it saves, or waits for Wi-Fi and then starts by itself.
stops: Big download ate the mobile data pack
